data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2018 were GBP 267.622m. The syndicate reports a small net favourable reassessment of prior accident years (a net surplus of GBP 3.8m) which relates to reassessment of net claims for previous years. The report does not disclose an explicit GROSS prior-year movement amount; only net prior-year reassessment is given. Catastrophe activity was significant in 2018 (Hurricanes Florence and Michael and the Camp and Woolsey wildfires) but overall 2018 catastrophe losses were lower than the large 2017 losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria), which contributed to an improved year-on-year loss ratio. The prior-year movement therefore appears driven by favourable reserve development rather than by a material single-event release disclosed on a gross basis.

data.data_quality_notes: The report provides an explicit net prior-year reassessment (net surplus of GBP 3.8m) but does not provide a single-line GROSS prior-year movement amount. The gross PYD requested by the schema is therefore not available explicitly; a gross claims development triangle is present (note 10) and could be used as a fallback to estimate gross PYD, but the triangle in the PDF is presented in a format that is only partially machine-extractable in this source. Where only net figures are stated they have not been used as the authoritative gross PYD. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
